quotes.text: 5. ¿Qué parentesco tiene con la jefa o jefe del hogar?
quotes.document: [C] CUESTIONARIO V9_bol_partir del cuarto trimestre de 2024.pdf

assessments.reasoning: Question 5 asks for the relationship of each household member to the head of household ('jefa o jefe del hogar'). However, the supplied questionnaire does not state or establish any method for identifying who the head of household is (whether self-declared by the household, designated by the respondent, or assigned by an explicit criterion). As the instrument does not establish a method, the selection is left empty.
